subject: [CRIT] True fault on Lab-Power - L07906
body:
Mei Tanaka, log L07906 is a TRUE fault (risk 99%).
Why: Wrong module: NINE says 'Antenna' but the log is from Lab-Power; Quoted value 11.41 != real reading 9.91; Reading 9.91 is 1.9 std from the Lab-Power normal; Calm tone ('all is well') on a CRIT log
Recommended: Emergency repair: threshold check fired on Lab-Power by Power Systems Engineer Mei Tanaka.
Slot: 2187-04-15 04:45 to 2187-04-15 05:30
